## Shop here for your Business

We are a family owned and operated business importing from origin for a more even value distribution
among the supply chain. We are innovators using cacao pulp and manufacturing with solar power. Our
strenght relies on quality and efficiency in logistics, importing, and distributing premium cacao
powder, cacao butter, cacao nibs, cacao fruit pulp, chocolate, couvertures, vanilla beans, and much
more! Our own brands of cacao products are made with the fine aroma cocoa beans preferred by highly
acclaimed international chocolate makers and the culinary industry.

Social Responsibility
We take pride in helping small cacao farming communities thrive. Our core values are our main drive
and we hope you join us to make this world a more equal, healthy, and eco-friendly place.

## Blife, passione per il biologico

### Il meglio del biologico, selezionato a misura del cliente e spedito in tutta Europa

# Importatore, esportatore, confezionatore e distributore di frutta e verdura fresca, frutta secca e
# materie prime biologiche

### Distributoredi prodotti a filiera bio certificata

Tutti i nostri prodotti provengono da una filiera biologica controllata, chiara e tracciabile

Blife racchiude la nostra passione per il Biologico e nasce dall’idea di selezionare ed offrire una
gamma di frutta, verdura, frutta secca e materie prime biologiche provenienti dai migliori
produttori nazionali e internazionali.

La sede operativa e di confezionamento è situata a Viterbo in zona Poggino con un magazzino dove è
possibile acquistare direttamente sia come grossisti che privati. Spediamo con corrieri refrigerati
in tutta Europa.

La nostra linea di confezionamento automatica 4.0 è in grado di soddisfare grandi esigenze di
confezionamento sia per produzione interna che conto terzi.

Per la nostra attività utilizziamo energia elettrica 100% pulita certificata, prodotta da fonti
rinnovabili senza l’emissione di CO2 nell’atmosfera e senza consumo di risorse naturali. L’energia
non è tutta uguale, noi abbiamo fatto una scelta buona per il pianeta e per il futuro delle prossime
generazioni.

Indonesia **is the largest producer of coconuts in the world**. Until now millions of coconut trees
thrive throughout this country. Indonesian people have used coconut trees as a high economic value

Sentosa**][41] is here to introduce organic coconut sugar and coconut-derived products from
Indonesia to the world.

We are one of Indonesia’s most trusted, and best organic coconut sugar factories. Therefore we have
won the trust to export bulk coconut sugar supplies (granules and blocks) to various companies in
the world. We work with farmers to produce coconut sugar from plantations in **Central Java –
Indonesia**. To this day, Organic Coconut Sugar and Conventional Coconut Sugar are the best-selling
products. Orders can be in the form of large quantities of coconut sugar and OEM Private label with
packaging customization.

certified **EU, USDA-NOP organic** with the number **CU847432**. In addition, we have also been
certified **Halal, **and **HACCP** in the food safety management system. Our Product currently
registered with the **General Administration of the People’s Republic of China Customs (GACC)**

###### About Us

## We Are Cartenz Cocoa

Cartenz Cocoa is an Indonesian chocolate brand, under PT. Persatuone Komoditas Indonesia. We are
inspired by Cartenz Summit, as the top summit in Indonesia. It’s along with our company’s philosophy
and mission: To Achieve your Cartenz! We want to help:
1. **Our cocoa farmers** achieve their Cartenz through sustainability, fair price, and welfare.
2. **Our beloved B2B customers** to achieve their Cartenz through build a profitable business with
   Cartenz Cocoa.
3. **Our beloved end customers** to achieve their Cartenz through happiness, mood increase, and
   health by consuming our products.
4. **Our team** to achieve their Cartenz through positive work environment.
According to World Cocoa Foundation, the demand for cocoa products increase 3% every year.
Therefore, We collaborate with Indonesian local farmers to provide high quality chocolate for global
needs. Established since 2000 as a family owned cocoa manufacturer with advanced technology and
cocoa experts, we process the best cocoa products and become one of the most trustworthy cocoa
powder exporter from Indonesia

and zinc when compared to other types of cacao products.

Our processing facilities produce natural and kosher Cacao Butter which is an essential ingredient
in chocolate and frequently used as an element in cosmetics, pharmaceuticals, toiletries, and the

chocolate to nutraceutical and cosmetic industries.

safe and reliable products and efficient professional services.

## Our Services

Thoughtful pre-sale and after-sale service, your worry-free partner.

#### Preliminary Technical Consultation

We provide professional preliminary technical consulting services, deeply understand your production
needs, process flow and existing equipment conditions, evaluate technical feasibility and put
forward optimization suggestions to ensure scientific and reasonable project planning. Our team of
experts will provide you with customized solution suggestions.

Based on the results of the preliminary consultation, we provide you with detailed solution design
services, covering system architecture, equipment selection, layout planning and automation
integration. Optimize the production line design to ensure the efficiency, reliability and economy
of the whole solution, and can be accurately implemented.

The professional team is responsible for equipment installation and ensures stable equipment
operation. Multi-scenario testing is carried out during the commissioning phase to optimize
performance indicators. In addition, we conduct practical training for operators. We also provide
engineer accompanying service to ensure smooth mass production.

#### After-sales Maintenance Service

We have established a complete after-sales maintenance system, providing regular inspections,
preventive maintenance, remote diagnosis and rapid response services to ensure the long-term stable
operation of Cocoa Machinery. For sudden failures, we provide 24/7 technical support and can
dispatch engineers to handle on-site if necessary.

## Powders

Established in 1901, Forbes Chocolate has built a legacy as a preeminent blender of cocoa and flavor
powders for dairy production.

order now

[Forbes Chocolate the early days]
[frame]

## Welcome To Forbes Chocolate

Forbes Chocolate is a developer and manufacturer of powdered food ingredients for use in food and
beverage products. Our product lines feature a wide variety of flavors, including cocoa powder in
several colors and fat ranges.

## Discover the Products

[img-discovery]

## [Cocoa Powder][12]

Certified and Conventional varieties in several strengths, colors and fat ranges for food, beverage,
and supplements.

[img-discovery]

## [Chocolate Dairy Powder][13]

Certified and Conventional stabilized cocoa powder varieties, available in several usage rates from
5 lbs. – 18 lbs.

[img-discovery]

## [Flavored Milk Powder][14]

Specially designed for milk in a wide variety of flavors, such as: orange, strawberry, vanilla, root
beer, among others.

[img-discovery]

## [Seasonal Flavor Powders][15]

An array of in-stock and seasonal flavors available with natural or Non-GMO ingredients.

[img-discovery]

## [Ice Cream Powder][16]

Forbes Chocolate blends chocolate ice cream flavor powders in a variety of strengths and colors.

[img-discovery]

## [Inclusions and Chocolate Pieces][17]

We carry chocolate chips and chocolate drops for dairies and ice cream manufacturers big and small.

## Services We offer

[milk-icon]

### Dairy Processors & Plant-Based Beverage Manufacturers

We provide a wide variety of flavor options, the ability to create unique flavors, and powders that
meet school nutritional data requirements.

[milk-icon]

### Ice Cream Manufacturers

Develop rich chocolate flavor profiles with Forbes ice cream powders, cocoa powders and inclusions.

[milk-icon]

### Artisanal Ice Cream Makers

Our full line of cocoa and chocolate ice cream powders are available in sizes suitable for shops and
restaurants.

[milk-icon]

### Supplement Manufacturers

We serve this growing industry with a variety of lab-tested, certified and conventional cocoa
powders.

[milk-icon]

### Baking and Snack Goods Manufacturers

Discover rich cocoa powder products for indulgent bakery taste and texture.

[milk-icon]

### Product Research and Development

Our team of product development and lab professionals can help you develop innovative flavors and
provide the technical support you need.

## Discover The Possibilities

[img]

## [Supplement & Nutraceutical][18]

A wide range of cocoa powders developed specifically to enhance the taste and visual appeal of
powdered supplements and RTD beverages.

[img]

## [Dairy & Plant Based Beverages][19]

Forbes can create custom flavors to suit your beverage development needs.  From traditional fruit
flavors to the latest trends, we can provide a wide range of flavor options.

[img]

## [Ice Cream][20]

Forbes offers a full spectrum of cocoa powder to meet your ice cream development needs.

[img]

## [Bakery][21]

Forbes has just the right cocoa for producing great taste, and the perfect appearance.  We can also
create custom cocoa powder blends to suit your bakery needs.

## Offering products for large manufacturers
## or artisan shops

[Learn More][22]

## The Right Products For You!

Those working in food research and development, food consultants, and product buyers can choose from
our line of standard flavors or we can help custom-blend any flavor profile. We serve manufacturers
of nutraceuticals and ice cream, milk processors and bakeries. Forbes works with companies of all
sizes, from large manufacturers to artisan shops.

We provide Non-GMO Project Verified and Fair Trade Certified cocoa. We offer natural, organic and
conventional cocoa powders that are Kosher and/or Halal certified.

actuales y futuras, de esta forma damos respuesta a un mercado y entorno cambiantes.  La diversidad
es una fuente de riqueza, creatividad e innovación y una forma de progreso hacia la igualdad de
oportunidades para nuestros empleados y candidatos.

trabajar”. Por eso, nos esforzamos cada día en ser una empresa atractiva en la que desarrollar una
carrera profesional. Trabajamos para lograr un buen clima laboral, donde las personas puedan crecer

medidas orientadas al bienestar, la salud y la seguridad de nuestra plantilla.

#### Who we are

India Cocoa is a leading name in the cocoa industry with a legacy of over 33 years in cultivating,
procuring, and processing high-quality cocoa across South India. A trusted partner for

local and international stakeholders, India Cocoa has built a strong reputation for delivering
excellence across all aspects of the cocoa value chain.

#### Our Story

Our story is no different from that of our produce. It started off like a simple bean, evolving
slowly, step by step, and over the years,  maturing into a one stop source for cocoa beans and cocoa
mass, an **evolution of over 33 years of experience in farming, procuring, processing, and supplying
cocoa **to an esteemed clientele. It is all about finding the right cocoa beans.

Fermenting and drying it to perfection that ensures all products from our beans bring out the best
possible flavours.

Our source of cocoa is one of the best in the country -

 the famed high ranges of KERALA (INDIA ) 

that rest cosily in the grand Western Ghats, the most

Renowned for superior quality crop, the produce 

from this region has helped us come up with the finest 

cut of products that have won hearts across the country and globe. We select the choicest of  cocoa
beans from the best of farms, process them at our fermenteries located in four different locales in
Kerala,

# Home

## About ** JBCOCOA **

**JB Cocoa** is the brand of premium cocoa ingredient products by JB Foods Limited, the
public-listed Group on the Singapore Exchange (SGX:BEW).

Established since the 2000s, JB Cocoa has grown to be one of the major cocoa ingredient producers in
the world. Our products, namely cocoa mass, cocoa butter and cocoa powder, are used to produce
chocolate, chocolate confectionary as well as cocoa-related food and beverages.

Known for our quality and service, JB Cocoa’s plants are state-of-the-art, utilising the latest
technology in cocoa processing and designed to be energy efficient.

[READ MORE ][50]

## Our** Products **

**[icon bean] Cocoa Mass      Cocoa Butter      Cocoa Powder**

### Cocoa Mass

We produce cocoa mass by carefully blending cocoa beans of different origins, and through precise
control of temperature and pressure.

### Cocoa Butter

We produce natural and deodorised cocoa butter, which is mainly used in the production of
chocolates.

### Cocoa Powder

We produce wide range of cocoa powder of varying pH value, application and fat content, used for
making cocoa beverages as well as confectionary.

## About ** JBCOCOA **

**JB Cocoa** is the brand of premium cocoa ingredient products by JB Foods Limited, the
public-listed Group on the Singapore Exchange (SGX:BEW).

Established since the 2000s, JB Cocoa has grown to be one of the major cocoa ingredient producers in
the world. Our products, namely cocoa mass, cocoa butter and cocoa powder, are used to produce
chocolate, chocolate confectionary as well as cocoa-related food and beverages.

Known for our quality and service, JB Cocoa’s plants are state-of-the-art, utilising the latest
technology in cocoa processing and designed to be energy efficient.

We produce wide range of cocoa powder of varying pH value, application and fat content, used for

[
* Karvil Machinery is the supplier of Siemens and provide the sigma blade mixer for its
  application. 
* The Karvil sigma mixer is also known as the Z blade mixer or sigma kneader mixer. It is used for
  the mixing and  kneading of high viscosity materials. 
* The Karvil sigma blade mixer caused by a pair of mutually cooperating and rotating Z blades to
  produce a strong shearing action so that the viscous materials enables to react quickly to obtain
  a uniform mixing. 
* Special "double Z" kneading arms for powerful mixing and kneading, adapted from experimentation to
  production.

## Answers before you ask.

Why choose Macar & Sons?

import directly instead of reselling, you get better pricing, fresher rotation, and the products
your customers actually ask for — delivered faster.

Do you sell to businesses like mine?

Yes — we supply grocery stores, restaurants, hotels, caterers and food service businesses of every
size, from single-location bistros to large retail chains, with order sizes tailored to your needs.

Are your products Halal?

reputable certifying organizations.

How fast is delivery, and where do you ship?

We deliver nationwide to all 50 states, with orders typically arriving in 1–3 business days from our
tri-temperature warehouse in Pompano Beach, Florida.

discounts applied as you build your order.

# What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

Copy pageCopy page
Copy pageCopy page
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external
systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP
provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.

## [
## ][30]
## What can MCP enable?
* Agents can access your Google Calendar and Notion, acting as a more personalized AI assistant.
* Claude Code can generate an entire web app using a Figma design.
* Enterprise chatbots can connect to multiple databases across an organization, empowering users to
  analyze data using chat.
* AI models can create 3D designs on Blender and print them out using a 3D printer.

## [
## ][31]
## Why does MCP matter?

Depending on where you sit in the ecosystem, MCP can have a range of benefits.
* **Developers**: MCP reduces development time and complexity when building, or integrating with, an
  AI application or agent.
* **AI applications or agents**: MCP provides access to an ecosystem of data sources, tools and apps
  which will enhance capabilities and improve the end-user experience.
* **End-users**: MCP results in more capable AI applications or agents which can access your data
  and take actions on your behalf when necessary.

## [
## ][32]
## Broad ecosystem support

MCP is an open protocol supported across a wide range of clients and servers. AI assistants like
[Claude][33] and [ChatGPT][34], development tools like [Visual Studio Code][35], [Cursor][36],
[MCPJam][37], and many others all support MCP — making it easy to build once and integrate
everywhere.

# What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

Copy pageCopy page
Copy pageCopy page
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external
systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP
provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.

## What can MCP enable?
* Agents can access your Google Calendar and Notion, acting as a more personalized AI assistant.
* Claude Code can generate an entire web app using a Figma design.
* Enterprise chatbots can connect to multiple databases across an organization, empowering users to
  analyze data using chat.
* AI models can create 3D designs on Blender and print them out using a 3D printer.

aimed at simplifying the process of choosing the suitable project for investment. It makes business
decisions easier and trouble-free by providing a list of right projects for investment. Unique among
project investment magazines, 'Entrepreneur India' is dedicated to the business of identifying sound
investment projects. Every issue consists of a new list of projects which are meticulously selected
by the Niir Project Consultancy Services (NPCS) team after being screened on various investment
factors. Niir Project Consultancy Services (NPCS) team, before labeling a project as 'Right
investment' studies various aspects of investment like product demand, market potential, raw

# Features

High performance real time video/audio capturing and mixing. Create scenes made up of multiple
sources including window captures, images, text, browser windows, webcams, capture cards and more.

Set up an unlimited number of scenes you can switch between seamlessly via custom transitions.

Intuitive audio mixer with per-source filters such as noise gate, noise suppression, and gain. Take
full control with VST plugin support.

Powerful and easy to use configuration options. Add new Sources, duplicate existing ones, and adjust
their properties effortlessly.

Streamlined Settings panel gives you access to a wide array of configuration options to tweak every
aspect of your broadcast or recording.

Modular 'Dock' UI allows you to rearrange the layout exactly as you like. You can even pop out each
individual Dock to its own window.

OBS supports all your favorite streaming platforms and more.

# Create Professional Productions

Choose from a number of different and customizable transitions for when you switch between your
scenes or add your own stinger video files.

Set hotkeys for nearly every sort of action, such as switching between scenes, starting/stopping
streams or recordings, muting audio sources, push to talk, and more.

**Studio Mode** lets you preview your scenes and sources before pushing them live. Adjust your
scenes and sources or create new ones and ensure they're perfect before your viewers ever see them.

Get a high level view of your production using the Multiview. Monitor 8 different scenes and easily
cue or transition to any of them with merely a single or double click.

# Collaborative Creativity

OBS Studio is equipped with a powerful API, enabling plugins and scripts to provide further
customization and functionality specific to your needs.

Utilize native plugins for high performance integrations or scripts written with Lua or Python that
interface with existing sources.

Work with developers in the streaming community to get the features you need with endless
possibilities.

Browse or submit your own in the [Resources section][24]

[ Dahi Saunf Tikki ][44]

on May 24 2024
Ingredients 500 gms – Dahi 2 pcs – Onions, chopped 4 pcs – Green chillies, chopped 1/2 tsp – Salt 75
gms – Cheese 1 tsp – Organic Tattva’s Fennel 2 tbsp – Organic Tattva’s Coriander seeds 2 tbsp –
Organic Tattva’s Black Pepper Powder 1 tbsp – Ginger, chopped 1 ½ tbsp – Red Chilli Flakes 1/2 cup –
Organic Tattva’s Besan, roasted 100 gms – Paneer 2 tbsp – Organic Tattva’s Corn Flour Oil for frying
Recipes Lay a muslin cloth over a bowl and pour the dahi into it. Pick up the edges of the cloth and
tie a knot. Hang it till it turns into a cheesy mixture Grind the saunf into a fine powder Grate the
cheese. Dry roast coriander seeds & black pepper and grind them into a powder Mix grated cheese, a
little coriander powder, along with the saunf powder, green chillies, onions, ginger and salt Take
the hung dahi in a bowl, add red chilli flakes and the rest of the mixture prepared in the step
above Bind with besan, paneer and corn flour Put in the filling and shape into kebabs Deep fry in
oil and serve hot Your delicious Dahi Saunf Tikki is ready to be served alongside fresh green
chutney

[ Vegetable Wheat Dalia ][46]

on May 24 2024
Ingredients 1 cup Organic Tattva Wheat dalia 1 medium sized onion, finely chopped 1 inch ginger,
finely chopped 1 or 2 green chilies 1 medium sized tomato ½ cup chopped carrots ½ cup chopped
potatoes ½ cup fresh green peas 4 cups water 1 teaspoon Organic Tattva cumin 1 tablespoon oil or
ghee Natural Tattva Salt to taste Recipes Heat oil or ghee in a pressure cooker on low flame. Add
the chopped onion and saute till they become translucent. Add 1 inch finely chopped ginger, 1 to 2

[ Dahi Saunf Tikki ][44]

on May 24 2024
Ingredients 500 gms – Dahi 2 pcs – Onions, chopped 4 pcs – Green chillies, chopped 1/2 tsp – Salt 75
gms – Cheese 1 tsp – Organic Tattva’s Fennel 2 tbsp – Organic Tattva’s Coriander seeds 2 tbsp –
Organic Tattva’s Black Pepper Powder 1 tbsp – Ginger, chopped 1 ½ tbsp – Red Chilli Flakes 1/2 cup –
Organic Tattva’s Besan, roasted 100 gms – Paneer 2 tbsp – Organic Tattva’s Corn Flour Oil for frying
Recipes Lay a muslin cloth over a bowl and pour the dahi into it. Pick up the edges of the cloth and
tie a knot. Hang it till it turns into a cheesy mixture Grind the saunf into a fine powder Grate the
cheese. Dry roast coriander seeds & black pepper and grind them into a powder Mix grated cheese, a
little coriander powder, along with the saunf powder, green chillies, onions, ginger and salt Take
the hung dahi in a bowl, add red chilli flakes and the rest of the mixture prepared in the step
above Bind with besan, paneer and corn flour Put in the filling and shape into kebabs Deep fry in
oil and serve hot Your delicious Dahi Saunf Tikki is ready to be served alongside fresh green
chutney

[ Vegetable Wheat Dalia ][46]

on May 24 2024
Ingredients 1 cup Organic Tattva Wheat dalia 1 medium sized onion, finely chopped 1 inch ginger,
finely chopped 1 or 2 green chilies 1 medium sized tomato ½ cup chopped carrots ½ cup chopped
potatoes ½ cup fresh green peas 4 cups water 1 teaspoon Organic Tattva cumin 1 tablespoon oil or
ghee Natural Tattva Salt to taste Recipes Heat oil or ghee in a pressure cooker on low flame. Add
the chopped onion and saute till they become translucent. Add 1 inch finely chopped ginger, 1 to 2
green chillies, and cumin. Add the chopped tomato and saute for 1 minute. Now add ½ cup chopped
potatoes, ½ cup chopped carrots and ½ cup of green peas. Saute on low to medium-low flame for
approximately 2 minutes. Rinse the dalia and add to the veggies. Cook on a low flame for 3 to 4
minutes. Add water and salt as required. Stir and pressure cook on medium flame for 10-12 whistles
or until the dalia is cooked well. Ensure you get a porridge like consistency. Garnish vegetable
daliya with coriander leaves and serve hot or warm.

[ Crispy Urad Dal Vada ][48]

on May 24 2024
Ingredients 1 cup Organic Tattva Urad Dal ¼ cup Organic Tattva Chana Dal 2 tsp Organic Tattva Rice
Flour 2 Green Chillies 3 tbsp Dry Chopped Coconut A few curry leaves 1 tbsp coriander leaves
(chopped) 1 inch ginger (finely chopped)) pinch of hing Natural tattva salt to taste oil to fry
Recipes Dash and soak the urad dal in about 3 cups of water for about 2-3 hours. Drain the water,
grind the urad dal and chana dal until you get a smooth paste. The consistency of the batter should
be thick. It is important to have the right consistency or otherwise, the vada will break when you
fry it. Add the coriander, green chillies, ginger and chopped dry coconut to the batter and mix
well. Add 2-3 tsp of rice flour. Add a pinch of hing. Heat the oil in a frying pan on medium flame.
Take a small portion of the batter and make a ball. Make hole in the center and slide it into the
hot oil. Ensure the vada floats on top of oil. Cook on medium flame until both sides of the vada
turn golden brown in colour. Serve hot with chutney of your choice or sambar.

When the Rodelle family moved to Denver, Colorado, from the south of France in 1936, they quickly
realized their new country lacked a high-quality pure vanilla extract for their recipes. So the
family of avid bakers decided to produce their own premium vanilla extract and founded Rodelle
Laboratories in 1936 to revolutionize the standard for gourmet flavors.

In today’s connected world, people want to know much more about the food they buy and consume than
they have in the past. We appreciate and embrace their desire for information. Testament to our
commitment to transparency are our direct relationships with vanilla farmers and streamlined supply
chain.

## Our products

For over 85 years, Rodelle has supplied kitchens like yours with top quality spices and flavors
sourced from around the world. Bring your baking to the next level with Rodelle's outstanding range
of gourmet baking and cooking products.

## Responsible vanilla

As one of the largest authentic vanilla extract manufacturers in the US, Rodelle takes pride in
being the gourmet flavoring producer of choice for many devoted bakers and culinary enthusiasts. Our
vanilla customers depend on us to supply a consistently excellent product for a fair price, which we
ensure through our progressive, hands-on approach to vanilla farming.

#### Shizuoka tea

Consistently cultivating quality tea leaves is but one part; the other is the fine art and science
of creating finished green tea. Bringing out highly desirable flavor from raw tea leaves requires a
delicate balance of creativity and skill. There are numerous ways of producing green tea, and the
tea master must follow precise steps taken in a timely manner. It is believed tea cultivation and
production in Shizuoka began during the Kamakura Period (1185-1333). The result of centuries of
accumulated blending and processing wisdom and mastery is evident in each new cup of Shizuoka green
tea.

#### Trusted Source for Premium Japanese Green Tea

ShizuokaTea.com sources the best available Japanese green tea from large, medium and small size
processing/packaging companies, and also directly from tea farmers. Our major suppliers collectively
have hundreds of years of experience, are highly skilled, operate very clean facilities and are ISO
Certified, which is very important in a time when there is concern for food safety. We are in
constant contact with the Japanese green tea industry from our year-around staffed buying office in
Shizuoka, Japan in an effort to bring our valued customers superior quality products.

## Home

## ** WHO WE ARE**

SunOpta delivers customized supply chain solutions and innovation for top brands, retailers and
foodservice providers across a broad portfolio of beverages, broths and better-for-you snacks.

[WHAT WE DO BEST]

## [WHAT WE DO BEST][150]

SunOpta delivers customized supply chain solutions that fuel and sustain our customers’ success.
Today SunOpta produces more than 200 organic certified products and 50 branded non-GMO Project
Verified products and ingredients.
[SUSTAINABILITY]

## [SUSTAINABILITY][151]

We aim to reduce our environmental footprint by finding solutions for more efficient use of
electricity, gas and water, achieving zero waste in our manufacturing facilities, developing
innovative packaging solutions, optimizing our transportation and responsibly sourcing our
ingredients.
[SAFETY AND QUALITY]

## [SAFETY AND QUALITY][152]

We care about the well-being of our employees, people in our supply chains, communities and
consumers. We strive to create a safe, healthy, inclusive and engaging work environment that fosters
innovation and continuous improvement, while prioritizing food safety and quality.

## OUR **PRODUCTS**

Our products include plant-based beverages, liquids and dry ingredients (using oat, almond, soy,
coconut and other bases) as well as broths, teas and nutritional beverages. We also manufacture
better-for-you snacks.

## **HOW WE GO TO MARKET**

With over 50 years of expertise, SunOpta fuels customers’ growth with high-quality,
sustainability-forward solutions distributed through retail, club, foodservice and e-commerce
channels across North America.

The Challenge

## The agri-food industry runs on opacity and manual effort.

01

### Information Asymmetry

Buyers and suppliers operate with wildly different levels of market visibility. Pricing,
availability, and quality data are fragmented, outdated, or locked behind intermediaries.

02

### Trust & Verification Gap

Finding reliable counterparties requires years of relationship-building, trade shows, and manual due
diligence. Verification is slow, expensive, and often unreliable.

03

### Execution Bottleneck

Even when opportunities are identified, execution remains manual -- outreach, negotiation, logistics
coordination, compliance, and follow-ups consume enormous time and resources.

OUR VISION

## Agri-food trade should work for everyone in it.

We believe that transparent data, verified networks, and intelligent automation can eliminate the
friction that holds global food trade back. Every buyer deserves fair prices. Every supplier
deserves market access. Every transaction should be efficient.

Data LayerNetwork LayerAI Layer

Together, these three layers form the foundation for a fundamentally better way to trade food
globally.

What ingredients are in your products?

temperature. If the product is too cold, the cocoa butter freezes and the spread look dense and
gritty.

If the product is too hot, the cocoa butter melts and the spreads get too runny.

The ideal temperature is room temperature. If it gets too hard, place it in a warm water bath for a
few minutes, give it a good stir and it will get creamy again.

PT Brilian Zenco Agroindo is a dedicated cocoa powder manufacturer for B2B buyers. We mill, press,
and refine premium alkalized and natural cocoa powders with stable color, aroma, and fat profiles
for food, beverage, confectionery, and bakery applications.

Our export network covers North Africa, South & Southeast Asia, and Europe, supplying consistent

running.

###### About Us

## We Are Cartenz Cocoa

Cartenz Cocoa is an Indonesian chocolate brand, under PT. Persatuone Komoditas Indonesia. We are
inspired by Cartenz Summit, as the top summit in Indonesia. It’s along with our company’s philosophy
and mission: To Achieve your Cartenz! We want to help:
1. **Our cocoa farmers** achieve their Cartenz through sustainability, fair price, and welfare.
2. **Our beloved B2B customers** to achieve their Cartenz through build a profitable business with
   Cartenz Cocoa.
3. **Our beloved end customers** to achieve their Cartenz through happiness, mood increase, and
   health by consuming our products.
4. **Our team** to achieve their Cartenz through positive work environment.
According to World Cocoa Foundation, the demand for cocoa products increase 3% every year.
Therefore, We collaborate with Indonesian local farmers to provide high quality chocolate for global
needs. Established since 2000 as a family owned cocoa manufacturer with advanced technology and
cocoa experts, we process the best cocoa products and become one of the most trustworthy cocoa
powder exporter from Indonesia

###### About Us

## We Are Cartenz Cocoa

Cartenz Cocoa is an Indonesian chocolate brand, under PT. Persatuone Komoditas Indonesia. We are
inspired by Cartenz Summit, as the top summit in Indonesia. It’s along with our company’s philosophy
and mission: To Achieve your Cartenz! We want to help:
1. **Our cocoa farmers** achieve their Cartenz through sustainability, fair price, and welfare.
2. **Our beloved B2B customers** to achieve their Cartenz through build a profitable business with
   Cartenz Cocoa.
3. **Our beloved end customers** to achieve their Cartenz through happiness, mood increase, and
   health by consuming our products.

## Welcome To Forbes Chocolate

Forbes Chocolate is a developer and manufacturer of powdered food ingredients for use in food and
beverage products. Our product lines feature a wide variety of flavors, including cocoa powder in
several colors and fat ranges.

## Discover the Products

[img-discovery]

## [Cocoa Powder][12]

Certified and Conventional varieties in several strengths, colors and fat ranges for food, beverage,
and supplements.

[img-discovery]

## [Chocolate Dairy Powder][13]

Certified and Conventional stabilized cocoa powder varieties, available in several usage rates from
5 lbs. – 18 lbs.

[img-discovery]

## [Flavored Milk Powder][14]

Specially designed for milk in a wide variety of flavors, such as: orange, strawberry, vanilla, root
beer, among others.

[img-discovery]

## [Seasonal Flavor Powders][15]

An array of in-stock and seasonal flavors available with natural or Non-GMO ingredients.

[img-discovery]

## [Ice Cream Powder][16]

Forbes Chocolate blends chocolate ice cream flavor powders in a variety of strengths and colors.

[img-discovery]

## [Inclusions and Chocolate Pieces][17]

We carry chocolate chips and chocolate drops for dairies and ice cream manufacturers big and small.

## Services We offer

[milk-icon]

### Dairy Processors & Plant-Based Beverage Manufacturers

We provide a wide variety of flavor options, the ability to create unique flavors, and powders that
meet school nutritional data requirements.

[milk-icon]

### Ice Cream Manufacturers

Develop rich chocolate flavor profiles with Forbes ice cream powders, cocoa powders and inclusions.

[milk-icon]

### Artisanal Ice Cream Makers

Our full line of cocoa and chocolate ice cream powders are available in sizes suitable for shops and
restaurants.

[milk-icon]

### Supplement Manufacturers

We serve this growing industry with a variety of lab-tested, certified and conventional cocoa
powders.

[milk-icon]

### Baking and Snack Goods Manufacturers

Discover rich cocoa powder products for indulgent bakery taste and texture.

# Home

## About ** JBCOCOA **

**JB Cocoa** is the brand of premium cocoa ingredient products by JB Foods Limited, the
public-listed Group on the Singapore Exchange (SGX:BEW).

Established since the 2000s, JB Cocoa has grown to be one of the major cocoa ingredient producers in

# What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

Copy pageCopy page
Copy pageCopy page
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external
systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP
provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.

## [
## ][30]
## What can MCP enable?
* Agents can access your Google Calendar and Notion, acting as a more personalized AI assistant.
* Claude Code can generate an entire web app using a Figma design.
* Enterprise chatbots can connect to multiple databases across an organization, empowering users to
  analyze data using chat.
* AI models can create 3D designs on Blender and print them out using a 3D printer.

## [
## ][31]
## Why does MCP matter?

Depending on where you sit in the ecosystem, MCP can have a range of benefits.
* **Developers**: MCP reduces development time and complexity when building, or integrating with, an
  AI application or agent.
* **AI applications or agents**: MCP provides access to an ecosystem of data sources, tools and apps
  which will enhance capabilities and improve the end-user experience.
* **End-users**: MCP results in more capable AI applications or agents which can access your data
  and take actions on your behalf when necessary.

## [
## ][32]
## Broad ecosystem support

MCP is an open protocol supported across a wide range of clients and servers. AI assistants like
[Claude][33] and [ChatGPT][34], development tools like [Visual Studio Code][35], [Cursor][36],
[MCPJam][37], and many others all support MCP — making it easy to build once and integrate
everywhere.

factors. Niir Project Consultancy Services (NPCS) team, before labeling a project as 'Right

# Features

High performance real time video/audio capturing and mixing. Create scenes made up of multiple
sources including window captures, images, text, browser windows, webcams, capture cards and more.

Set up an unlimited number of scenes you can switch between seamlessly via custom transitions.

Intuitive audio mixer with per-source filters such as noise gate, noise suppression, and gain. Take
full control with VST plugin support.

Powerful and easy to use configuration options. Add new Sources, duplicate existing ones, and adjust
their properties effortlessly.

Streamlined Settings panel gives you access to a wide array of configuration options to tweak every
aspect of your broadcast or recording.

Modular 'Dock' UI allows you to rearrange the layout exactly as you like. You can even pop out each
individual Dock to its own window.

OBS supports all your favorite streaming platforms and more.

# Create Professional Productions

Choose from a number of different and customizable transitions for when you switch between your
scenes or add your own stinger video files.

Set hotkeys for nearly every sort of action, such as switching between scenes, starting/stopping
streams or recordings, muting audio sources, push to talk, and more.

**Studio Mode** lets you preview your scenes and sources before pushing them live. Adjust your
scenes and sources or create new ones and ensure they're perfect before your viewers ever see them.

Get a high level view of your production using the Multiview. Monitor 8 different scenes and easily
cue or transition to any of them with merely a single or double click.

# Collaborative Creativity

OBS Studio is equipped with a powerful API, enabling plugins and scripts to provide further
customization and functionality specific to your needs.

Utilize native plugins for high performance integrations or scripts written with Lua or Python that
interface with existing sources.

Work with developers in the streaming community to get the features you need with endless
possibilities.

Browse or submit your own in the [Resources section][24]

[ Dahi Saunf Tikki ][44]

on May 24 2024
Ingredients 500 gms – Dahi 2 pcs – Onions, chopped 4 pcs – Green chillies, chopped 1/2 tsp – Salt 75
gms – Cheese 1 tsp – Organic Tattva’s Fennel 2 tbsp – Organic Tattva’s Coriander seeds 2 tbsp –
Organic Tattva’s Black Pepper Powder 1 tbsp – Ginger, chopped 1 ½ tbsp – Red Chilli Flakes 1/2 cup –
Organic Tattva’s Besan, roasted 100 gms – Paneer 2 tbsp – Organic Tattva’s Corn Flour Oil for frying
Recipes Lay a muslin cloth over a bowl and pour the dahi into it. Pick up the edges of the cloth and
tie a knot. Hang it till it turns into a cheesy mixture Grind the saunf into a fine powder Grate the
cheese. Dry roast coriander seeds & black pepper and grind them into a powder Mix grated cheese, a
little coriander powder, along with the saunf powder, green chillies, onions, ginger and salt Take
the hung dahi in a bowl, add red chilli flakes and the rest of the mixture prepared in the step
above Bind with besan, paneer and corn flour Put in the filling and shape into kebabs Deep fry in
oil and serve hot Your delicious Dahi Saunf Tikki is ready to be served alongside fresh green
chutney

[ Vegetable Wheat Dalia ][46]

on May 24 2024
Ingredients 1 cup Organic Tattva Wheat dalia 1 medium sized onion, finely chopped 1 inch ginger,
finely chopped 1 or 2 green chilies 1 medium sized tomato ½ cup chopped carrots ½ cup chopped
potatoes ½ cup fresh green peas 4 cups water 1 teaspoon Organic Tattva cumin 1 tablespoon oil or
ghee Natural Tattva Salt to taste Recipes Heat oil or ghee in a pressure cooker on low flame. Add
the chopped onion and saute till they become translucent. Add 1 inch finely chopped ginger, 1 to 2
green chillies, and cumin. Add the chopped tomato and saute for 1 minute. Now add ½ cup chopped
potatoes, ½ cup chopped carrots and ½ cup of green peas. Saute on low to medium-low flame for
approximately 2 minutes. Rinse the dalia and add to the veggies. Cook on a low flame for 3 to 4
minutes. Add water and salt as required. Stir and pressure cook on medium flame for 10-12 whistles
or until the dalia is cooked well. Ensure you get a porridge like consistency. Garnish vegetable
daliya with coriander leaves and serve hot or warm.

[Crispy Urad Dal Vada]
][47]

[ Crispy Urad Dal Vada ][48]

on May 24 2024
Ingredients 1 cup Organic Tattva Urad Dal ¼ cup Organic Tattva Chana Dal 2 tsp Organic Tattva Rice
Flour 2 Green Chillies 3 tbsp Dry Chopped Coconut A few curry leaves 1 tbsp coriander leaves
(chopped) 1 inch ginger (finely chopped)) pinch of hing Natural tattva salt to taste oil to fry
Recipes Dash and soak the urad dal in about 3 cups of water for about 2-3 hours. Drain the water,
grind the urad dal and chana dal until you get a smooth paste. The consistency of the batter should
be thick. It is important to have the right consistency or otherwise, the vada will break when you
fry it. Add the coriander, green chillies, ginger and chopped dry coconut to the batter and mix
well. Add 2-3 tsp of rice flour. Add a pinch of hing. Heat the oil in a frying pan on medium flame.
Take a small portion of the batter and make a ball. Make hole in the center and slide it into the
hot oil. Ensure the vada floats on top of oil. Cook on medium flame until both sides of the vada
turn golden brown in colour. Serve hot with chutney of your choice or sambar.

## A rich history of flavors

When the Rodelle family moved to Denver, Colorado, from the south of France in 1936, they quickly
realized their new country lacked a high-quality pure vanilla extract for their recipes. So the
family of avid bakers decided to produce their own premium vanilla extract and founded Rodelle
Laboratories in 1936 to revolutionize the standard for gourmet flavors.

In today’s connected world, people want to know much more about the food they buy and consume than
they have in the past. We appreciate and embrace their desire for information. Testament to our
commitment to transparency are our direct relationships with vanilla farmers and streamlined supply
chain.

## Our products

For over 85 years, Rodelle has supplied kitchens like yours with top quality spices and flavors
sourced from around the world. Bring your baking to the next level with Rodelle's outstanding range
of gourmet baking and cooking products.

## Responsible vanilla

As one of the largest authentic vanilla extract manufacturers in the US, Rodelle takes pride in
being the gourmet flavoring producer of choice for many devoted bakers and culinary enthusiasts. Our
vanilla customers depend on us to supply a consistently excellent product for a fair price, which we
ensure through our progressive, hands-on approach to vanilla farming.

#### Shizuoka tea

Consistently cultivating quality tea leaves is but one part; the other is the fine art and science
of creating finished green tea. Bringing out highly desirable flavor from raw tea leaves requires a
delicate balance of creativity and skill. There are numerous ways of producing green tea, and the
tea master must follow precise steps taken in a timely manner. It is believed tea cultivation and
production in Shizuoka began during the Kamakura Period (1185-1333). The result of centuries of
accumulated blending and processing wisdom and mastery is evident in each new cup of Shizuoka green
tea.

#### Trusted Source for Premium Japanese Green Tea

ShizuokaTea.com sources the best available Japanese green tea from large, medium and small size
processing/packaging companies, and also directly from tea farmers. Our major suppliers collectively
have hundreds of years of experience, are highly skilled, operate very clean facilities and are ISO
Certified, which is very important in a time when there is concern for food safety. We are in
constant contact with the Japanese green tea industry from our year-around staffed buying office in
Shizuoka, Japan in an effort to bring our valued customers superior quality products.

SunOpta delivers customized supply chain solutions that fuel and sustain our customers’ success.

## [SUSTAINABILITY][151]

We aim to reduce our environmental footprint by finding solutions for more efficient use of
electricity, gas and water, achieving zero waste in our manufacturing facilities, developing
innovative packaging solutions, optimizing our transportation and responsibly sourcing our
ingredients.
[SAFETY AND QUALITY]

## [SAFETY AND QUALITY][152]

We care about the well-being of our employees, people in our supply chains, communities and
consumers. We strive to create a safe, healthy, inclusive and engaging work environment that fosters
innovation and continuous improvement, while prioritizing food safety and quality.

## OUR **PRODUCTS**

Our products include plant-based beverages, liquids and dry ingredients (using oat, almond, soy,
coconut and other bases) as well as broths, teas and nutritional beverages. We also manufacture
better-for-you snacks.

## **HOW WE GO TO MARKET**

With over 50 years of expertise, SunOpta fuels customers’ growth with high-quality,
sustainability-forward solutions distributed through retail, club, foodservice and e-commerce
channels across North America.

The Challenge

## The agri-food industry runs on opacity and manual effort.

01

### Information Asymmetry

Buyers and suppliers operate with wildly different levels of market visibility. Pricing,
availability, and quality data are fragmented, outdated, or locked behind intermediaries.

02

### Trust & Verification Gap

Finding reliable counterparties requires years of relationship-building, trade shows, and manual due
diligence. Verification is slow, expensive, and often unreliable.

03

### Execution Bottleneck

Even when opportunities are identified, execution remains manual -- outreach, negotiation, logistics
coordination, compliance, and follow-ups consume enormous time and resources.

OUR VISION

## Agri-food trade should work for everyone in it.

We believe that transparent data, verified networks, and intelligent automation can eliminate the
friction that holds global food trade back. Every buyer deserves fair prices. Every supplier
deserves market access. Every transaction should be efficient.

Data LayerNetwork LayerAI Layer

Together, these three layers form the foundation for a fundamentally better way to trade food
globally.

You’ve got questions, we’ve got answers.

What ingredients are in your products?

Veraila Noire: Hazelnuts (55%), organic cane sugar, organic fair-trade dark chocolate, organic
vanilla powder

Veraila Pure: Hazelnuts (68%), organic cocoa mass, organic dates

Are your ingredients organic?

Although we are not certified organic, we try to use as many organic ingredients as possible.
Currently, all of our ingredients except for hazelnuts are organic. We aim to switch to organic
hazelnuts and get USDA organic certification as soon as it is financially feasable.

Are your products vegan?

Yes! Both of our products are vegan.

What is the shelf-life?

An unopened jar is good for 9 months after production. Since we produce in small-batches, you are
likely to receive a fresh batch made in the last 1-2 months.

After opening, we recommend finishing it within 2-3 weeks. Based on our customer feedback, finishing
a jar in 2-3 weeks is not a problem!

My spread was not as creamy as shown. What's up?

Since we don't use any palm oil or emulsifiers, the texture of the product changes with the
temperature. If the product is too cold, the cocoa butter freezes and the spread look dense and
gritty.

If the product is too hot, the cocoa butter melts and the spreads get too runny.

The ideal temperature is room temperature. If it gets too hard, place it in a warm water bath for a
few minutes, give it a good stir and it will get creamy again.
